s.id, s.workspace_id, s.message_seq_high_water, s.mission_taint_generation, s.mission_taint_seq, s.title_privacy_generation, s.created_by_user_id, CASE WHEN s.title_user_set = TRUE OR s.mission_taint_seq IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_privacy_barrier title_barrier WHERE title_barrier.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND title_barrier.blocked = FALSE AND title_barrier.generation = COALESCE(s.title_privacy_generation, s.mission_taint_generation) ) THEN s.title ELSE '' END AS title, s.title_user_set, s.visibility, s.status, (SELECT p.status FROM ai_chat_session_participant p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.session_id = s.id AND p.user_id = #{userId}) AS participation_status, CASE WHEN s.created_by_user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS owned_by_current_user, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_chat_message summary_message WHERE summary_message.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND summary_message.session_id = s.id AND summary_message.author_kind = 'system' AND summary_message.mission_run_id IS NULL AND (s.mission_taint_seq IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_privacy_barrier summary_barrier WHERE summary_barrier.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND summary_barrier.blocked = FALSE AND summary_barrier.generation = COALESCE(summary_message.privacy_generation, s.mission_taint_generation) )) ) AS history_summarized, s.last_message_at, s.archived_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at

s.id, s.workspace_id, s.message_seq_high_water, s.mission_taint_generation, s.mission_taint_seq, s.title_privacy_generation, s.created_by_user_id, CASE WHEN s.title_user_set = TRUE OR s.mission_taint_seq IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_privacy_barrier title_barrier WHERE title_barrier.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND title_barrier.blocked = FALSE AND title_barrier.generation = COALESCE(s.title_privacy_generation, s.mission_taint_generation) ) THEN s.title ELSE '' END AS title, s.title_user_set, s.visibility, s.status, (SELECT p.status FROM ai_chat_session_participant p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.session_id = s.id AND p.user_id = #{userId}) AS participation_status, CASE WHEN s.created_by_user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS owned_by_current_user, FALSE AS history_summarized, s.last_message_at, s.archived_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at

SELECT s.id, s.workspace_id, s.message_seq_high_water, s.mission_taint_generation, s.mission_taint_seq, s.title_privacy_generation, s.created_by_user_id, CASE WHEN s.title_user_set = TRUE OR s.mission_taint_seq IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_privacy_barrier title_barrier WHERE title_barrier.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND title_barrier.blocked = FALSE AND title_barrier.generation = COALESCE(s.title_privacy_generation, s.mission_taint_generation) ) THEN s.title ELSE '' END AS title, s.title_user_set, s.visibility, s.status, NULL AS participation_status, FALSE AS owned_by_current_user, FALSE AS history_summarized, s.last_message_at, s.archived_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM ai_chat_session s WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session (workspace_id, created_by_user_id, title, title_user_set, visibility, status) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{createdByUserId}, #{title}, #{titleUserSet}, #{visibility}, #{status})
mapper.update:
UPDATE ai_chat_session
title = #{title}, title_user_set = TRUE,
status = #{status}, archived_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'archived' THEN COALESCE(archived_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ELSE NULL END,
visibility = #{visibility},
WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session_participant (workspace_id, session_id, user_id, status, joined_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, 'joined', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT INTO ai_chat_session_participant (workspace_id, session_id, user_id, invited_by_user_id, status, invited_at, joined_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{invitedByUserId}, 'invited', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT recipient.user_id FROM ( SELECT s.created_by_user_id AS user_id FROM ai_chat_session s WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.id = #{sessionId} AND s.created_by_user_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT p.user_id FROM ai_chat_session s JOIN ai_chat_session_participant p ON p.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND p.session_id = s.id AND p.status = 'joined' WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.id = #{sessionId} AND s.visibility = 'shared' ) recipient ORDER BY recipient.user_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_message (workspace_id, session_id, seq, author_kind, author_user_id, content, structured_json, input_tokens, output_tokens, mission_run_id, mission_message_kind, privacy_generation) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{authorKind}, #{authorUserId}, #{content}, #{structuredJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{inputTokens,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{outputTokens,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{missionRunId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{missionMessageKind,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{privacyGeneration,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: SELECT recent.id, recent.workspace_id, recent.session_id, recent.seq, recent.author_kind, recent.author_user_id, recent.content, recent.structured_json, recent.input_tokens, recent.output_tokens, recent.mission_run_id, recent.mission_message_kind, recent.privacy_generation, recent.created_at FROM ( SELECT id, workspace_id, session_id, seq, author_kind, author_user_id, content, structured_json, input_tokens, output_tokens, mission_run_id, mission_message_kind, privacy_generation, created_at FROM ai_chat_message WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND seq <= #{maxSeq} AND author_kind IN ('user', 'assistant') ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent ORDER BY recent.seq ASC

SELECT id, workspace_id, session_id, seq, author_kind, author_user_id, content, structured_json, input_tokens, output_tokens, mission_run_id, mission_message_kind, privacy_generation, created_at FROM ai_chat_message WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND author_kind = 'assistant' ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, workspace_id, session_id, seq, author_kind, author_user_id, content, structured_json, input_tokens, output_tokens, mission_run_id, mission_message_kind, privacy_generation, created_at FROM ai_chat_message WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND author_kind = 'system' ORDER BY seq ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_turn (workspace_id, session_id, requested_by_user_id, status, scope_json, privacy_mode, streamed, privacy_generation, privacy_taint_seq) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{requestedByUserId}, #{status}, #{scopeJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{privacyMode}, #{streamed}, #{privacyGeneration,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{privacyTaintSeq,jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t.workspace_id FROM ai_chat_turn t LEFT JOIN ai_run_lease l ON l.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND l.subject_kind = 'chat_turn' AND l.subject_id = t.id WHERE t.mission_run_id IS NULL AND t.status IN ('queued', 'running') AND t.updated_at <= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{lifetimeSeconds} SECOND) AND t.workspace_id > #{afterWorkspaceId} AND l.subject_id IS NULL ORDER BY t.workspace_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.session_id, t.id FROM ai_chat_turn t LEFT JOIN ai_run_lease l ON l.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND l.subject_kind = 'chat_turn' AND l.subject_id = t.id WHERE t.mission_run_id IS NULL AND t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.status IN ('queued', 'running') AND t.updated_at <= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{lifetimeSeconds} SECOND) AND l.subject_id IS NULL ORDER BY t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, workspace_id, session_id, requested_by_user_id, status, terminal_reason, skill_key, skill_version, scope_json, mission_run_id, mission_segment_id, privacy_generation, privacy_taint_seq, privacy_mode, streamed, partial_content, partial_content_utf16_offset, cancel_requested_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_chat_turn WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND mission_run_id IS NULL AND status IN ('queued', 'running') ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, workspace_id, session_id, requested_by_user_id, status, terminal_reason, skill_key, skill_version, scope_json, mission_run_id, mission_segment_id, privacy_generation, privacy_taint_seq, privacy_mode, streamed, partial_content, partial_content_utf16_offset, cancel_requested_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_chat_turn WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('queued', 'running') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_tool_call (workspace_id, message_id, tool_name, status, arguments_json, thought_signature, idempotency_key, server_proposal, mission_run_id, artifact_origin, privacy_generation) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{messageId}, #{toolName}, #{status}, #{argumentsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{thoughtSignature,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{idempotencyKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{serverProposal}, #{missionRunId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{artifactOrigin}, #{privacyGeneration,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: SELECT tc.*, m.session_id, m.author_user_id AS requested_by_user_id FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND m.id = tc.message_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND tc.message_id = #{messageId} AND tc.id = #{id} AND

SELECT tc.id, tc.workspace_id, tc.message_id, m.session_id, m.author_user_id AS requested_by_user_id, tc.tool_name, tc.status, tc.arguments_json, tc.thought_signature, tc.result_json, tc.executed_by_user_id, tc.executed_at, tc.idempotency_key, tc.server_proposal, tc.mission_run_id, tc.artifact_origin, tc.privacy_generation, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND m.id = tc.message_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND AND tc.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT tc.id, tc.workspace_id, tc.message_id, m.session_id, m.author_user_id AS requested_by_user_id, tc.tool_name, tc.status, tc.arguments_json, tc.thought_signature, tc.result_json, tc.executed_by_user_id, tc.executed_at, tc.idempotency_key, tc.server_proposal, tc.mission_run_id, tc.artifact_origin, tc.privacy_generation, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND m.id = tc.message_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND AND m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND tc.id = #{id}

SELECT tc.artifact_origin FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND m.id = tc.message_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND tc.id = #{id}

SELECT tc.id, tc.workspace_id, tc.message_id, m.session_id, m.author_user_id AS requested_by_user_id, tc.tool_name, tc.status, tc.arguments_json, tc.thought_signature, tc.result_json, tc.executed_by_user_id, tc.executed_at, tc.idempotency_key, tc.server_proposal, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND m.id = tc.message_id JOIN ai_chat_message boundary ON boundary.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND boundary.session_id = m.session_id AND boundary.id = #{afterMessageId} WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND tc.status = 'proposed' AND tc.server_proposal = TRUE AND (m.seq > boundary.seq OR (m.seq = boundary.seq AND tc.id > #{afterToolCallId})) ORDER BY m.seq DESC, tc.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tc.id, tc.workspace_id, tc.message_id, m.session_id, m.author_user_id AS requested_by_user_id, tc.tool_name, tc.status, tc.arguments_json, tc.thought_signature, tc.result_json, tc.executed_by_user_id, tc.executed_at, tc.idempotency_key, tc.server_proposal, tc.mission_run_id, tc.artifact_origin, tc.privacy_generation, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND m.id = tc.message_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND AND m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND tc.idempotency_key LIKE CONCAT(#{idempotencyPrefix}, '%') ORDER BY tc.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tc.id, tc.workspace_id, tc.message_id, m.session_id, m.author_user_id AS requested_by_user_id, tc.tool_name, tc.status, tc.arguments_json, tc.thought_signature, tc.result_json, tc.executed_by_user_id, tc.executed_at, tc.idempotency_key, tc.server_proposal, tc.mission_run_id, tc.artifact_origin, tc.privacy_generation, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND m.id = tc.message_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND tc.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_tool_call SET result_json = #{resultJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, executed_by_user_id = #{executedByUserId}, executed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'executed'
